title: Creating and editing GPTs
finding_used: Instructions/Knowledge separation; trigger-action guidance; Preview; capabilities; Apps vs Actions
v7_design_implication: Runtime/Knowledge split, installation, capability matrix
limitation: Platform behavior can change

title: GPTs in ChatGPT
finding_used: GPTs start fresh; recommended model can be switched/replaced; GPT vs API boundary
v7_design_implication: No memory/persistence claims; model-change tests; Integrated Agent boundary
limitation: Plan/workspace availability varies

title: Configuring actions in GPTs
finding_used: Actions require API details, auth, schema; Apps and Actions mutually exclusive
v7_design_implication: Separate agent integration architecture and auth design
limitation: External API implementation still required

title: Apps in ChatGPT
finding_used: Apps can search, sync, and sometimes write; confirmation and admin controls apply
v7_design_implication: Treat app capabilities as explicit and permissioned
limitation: Availability varies by plan/workspace/app

title: GPT-5.6 model guidance
finding_used: Leaner prompts, representative evals, explicit autonomy boundaries, task-specific tool routing
v7_design_implication: Runtime reduction; approval policy stated once; evaluation-first migration
limitation: API guidance is directional for Custom GPTs

title: How evals drive the next chapter in AI for businesses
finding_used: Specify-measure-improve; golden sets; review real outputs; error taxonomy; data flywheel
v7_design_implication: Executable registry, real prompts, raw output review
limitation: Business primer, not a controlled experiment

title: Predicting model behavior before release by simulating deployment
finding_used: Deployment-like prompts improve estimates and expose failures missed by narrow tests
v7_design_implication: Anonymized real prompt suite and ordinary cases
limitation: Requires sufficient representative data; complements adversarial tests

title: A shared playbook for trustworthy third-party evaluations
finding_used: Report claim, tasks, tested system, budget, elicitation, and validity checks
v7_design_implication: Expanded run metadata and harness reporting
limitation: Frontier evaluation focus; adapted to product evals

title: Improving instruction hierarchy in frontier LLMs
finding_used: Trust hierarchy improves steerability and prompt-injection robustness
v7_design_implication: Evidence-as-data rule and injection suite
limitation: Model training does not eliminate application-level risk

title: Designing AI agents to resist prompt injection
finding_used: Real attacks resemble social engineering in external content
v7_design_implication: Task-alignment security gate and dynamic injection cases
limitation: No perfect prompt-only defense

title: Separating signal from noise in coding evaluations
finding_used: Benchmark defects can materially distort capability claims
v7_design_implication: Benchmark defect audit and human adjudication
limitation: Coding benchmark focus; principle generalized cautiously

title: SCULPT: Systematic Tuning of Long Prompts
finding_used: Hierarchical targeted prompt edits can preserve long-prompt integrity and improve stability
v7_design_implication: Modular prompt architecture and smallest-change repairs
limitation: Task/model-specific results

title: Lost in the Middle
finding_used: Relevant information position can materially affect long-context use
v7_design_implication: Keep core rules lean/prominent; test Knowledge retrieval
limitation: Older model set; current models may improve

title: LiveBench
finding_used: Fresh, objective, contamination-limited tasks reduce benchmark leakage and judge dependence
v7_design_implication: Rotate holdouts and favor deterministic checks
limitation: General capability benchmark, not Custom GPT specific

title: Judging the Judges
finding_used: Position bias varies across judges/tasks and is not random
v7_design_implication: Blind labels; randomize/reverse order; report stability
limitation: Pairwise/listwise benchmark settings

title: Bias in the Loop
finding_used: Repeated judge decisions and small prompt changes can alter conclusions
v7_design_implication: Repeat grading and use deterministic/human controls
limitation: Preprint; software-engineering domain

title: Agent Security Bench
finding_used: Agent vulnerabilities span prompts, tools, memory, and mixed attacks
v7_design_implication: Agent security suite across lifecycle stages
limitation: Broad benchmark; defenses remain incomplete

title: WASP
finding_used: Realistic end-to-end web-agent prompt injections remain effective
v7_design_implication: Realistic multi-step injection tests
limitation: Web-agent environment may differ from Custom GPT

title: Task Shield
finding_used: Checking that actions serve the user task can reduce injection success while retaining utility
v7_design_implication: Six-question task-alignment gate before tool actions
limitation: Reported results are model/benchmark specific

title: WebArena
finding_used: Realistic web tasks expose large end-to-end reliability gaps
v7_design_implication: Do not equate tool access with reliable completion; test end to end
limitation: Older baseline models; environment is simulated

title: ToolEmu
finding_used: Tool-emulated sandboxes can surface realistic high-stakes agent failures at scale
v7_design_implication: Sandbox risky agent designs before real integration
limitation: Automatic evaluator has imperfect validity

title: GAIA
finding_used: Simple human tasks requiring tools and browsing can remain hard for assistants
v7_design_implication: Use realistic end-to-end task success, not component claims
limitation: Older systems and general benchmark

title: RAGTruth
finding_used: RAG can still produce unsupported or contradictory content
v7_design_implication: Evaluate Knowledge faithfulness separately from retrieval
limitation: Dataset tasks differ from MyGPT building

title: RAGAs
finding_used: RAG evaluation should separate context relevance, faithfulness, and answer quality
v7_design_implication: Separate retrieval and generation dimensions
limitation: Automated metrics need validation

title: ARES
finding_used: Few human labels can calibrate automated RAG evaluation across components
v7_design_implication: Use human calibration with automated graders
limitation: Requires evaluation setup and annotations

title: Know Your Limits: Abstention in LLMs
finding_used: Selective abstention is a core reliability mechanism with task/value tradeoffs
v7_design_implication: Use missing-evidence downgrade and recommendation abstention
limitation: Survey; implementation must be tested

title: Clarify When Necessary
finding_used: Clarification value depends on intent uncertainty and user speed/carefulness tradeoff
v7_design_implication: Ask only decision-changing questions; test missed vs unnecessary questions
limitation: Research tasks differ from GPT architecture dialogue

title: Benchmark contamination mitigation study
finding_used: Many semantic benchmark-refresh strategies fail to balance fidelity and contamination resistance
v7_design_implication: Keep rotating private real prompts; do not trust cosmetic rewrites
limitation: Model benchmark contamination differs from prompt overfitting

title: How Much Can We Forget about Data Contamination?
finding_used: Contamination effects vary with scale and training; simplistic assumptions are unsafe
v7_design_implication: Label holdout exposure and maintain fresh cases
limitation: Training-data contamination not identical to local prompt tuning

title: Benchmarking LLM Faithfulness in RAG
finding_used: Faithfulness evaluators need diverse human-annotated examples and meta-evaluation
v7_design_implication: Human review and evolving faithfulness tests
limitation: Industry study; tool specifics may differ
